apps.name: YTKillerPlus
apps.subtitle: Advanced YouTube tweak with extensive controls
apps.localizedDescription: YTKillerPlus is an advanced feature-packed YouTube tweak by iKarwan. It offers comprehensive ad blocking, background playback, high-speed downloads, PiP, custom player actions, OLED dark theme, and granular privacy controls.
apps.versionDescription:
YouTube 21.35.3 | YouTube_21.35_YTKillerPlus_6.5

• v21.34 requires iOS 17 and later now
• Fix HLS CKU clear known url for audio mp3 and 2k-4k capable devices fails on v21.31+ in some cases
• Fix save posted gif image saving only first frame in some cases
• Fix save posted image when multiple imge in a post first image not saved correctly
• Fix tabs Icon.
• Fix and improve audio languages select.
• Updated iPA to newer YouTube v21.34.6.
• Add POST tab to tab bar.
• Improve localization & add missing languages.
• Improve ad blocking on main Feed.
• Improve Lyrics API speed & accuracy.
• Improve MP3 audio handling.
• Improve backup & restore.
• Improve media extension importing.
• Improve Shorts auto-skip.
• Improve Shorts multiple-post handling.
• Fix OLED keyboard issue on iOS 27.
• Other fixes & cleanup.
• Updated iPA to YouTube v21.35
